title: ALMA Observations of the Interaction of a Radio Jet with Molecular Gas in Minkowski's Object
question: Is there molecular gas in Minkowski's Object, and do its properties support jet-induced star formation (positive AGN feedback)?

data.bands: CO(1-0) at 113.15 GHz plus continuum windows at 99.2, 101.1, 111.2 GHz (Band 3)
data.angular_resolution: CO beam 3.2" x 2.4", PA 275 deg; continuum 3.5" x 2.6"
data.sensitivity: CO: 0.5 mJy/beam per 3 km/s channel; continuum: 60 uJy/beam

what.value: H-alpha image used for SFR surface density

evidence.loc: 5.1 Star formation rate and gas depletion time
evidence.quote: by scaling the CO(1-0) image and the H$\alpha$ image (from C06)

evidence.loc: 5.1 Star formation rate and gas depletion time
evidence.quote: we assume a SFR of 0.47 M$_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$ (Salomé et al. 2015)
C06 give the atomic gas mass in H`I` as $4.9\times 10^8 M_{\odot}$

recipe.method: CASA clean MFS (2 Taylor terms) for continuum, natural weighting; uvcontsub for CO cube
convolve ALMA image to VLA resolution and compute per-pixel spectral index

recipe.goal: Measure CO flux and correct for resolved-out emission
recipe.method: Integrate over 16" aperture, 5535-5586 km/s; simulate spatial filtering to derive factor 1.4
assumptions: emission is a uniform disk of 16" diameter; 20% uncertainty

recipe.method: Obreschkow L_CO formula; M_H2 = alpha_CO * L_CO for alpha_CO=4.6 and 27

recipe.goal: Star formation law and depletion time
recipe.method: Scale CO and H-alpha images to Sigma_H2 and Sigma_SFR; depletion time = ratio; compare with Kennicutt-Schmidt
standard equipartition formulation from VLA 1.5 GHz
assumptions: kappa=100, filling factor 1, path length 4.0 kpc, phi=45 deg, alpha=-0.8

evidence.quote: $M_{\rm H_2} =3.0 \times 10^7~M_{\odot}$, 6% of the H`I` gas mass
we find a minimum pressure of $1.3 \times 10^{-12}$ Pa

evidence.loc: 5.1 Star formation rate and gas depletion time
evidence.quote: this leads to a short average gas depletion timescale $\sim 0.6-3.8\times 10^8$ yr

not_stated_but_needed: Clean threshold, masking, cell and image size
Details of the ALMA simulator setup (configuration, noise)
How pixel-level Sigma_SFR was derived from H-alpha (extinction, calibration)
Spectral-fitting method for clump line parameters
score_reason: Data public and main numbers clear, but many imaging parameters are unstated.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data, simple flux and mass derivation with numeric results.
